summary: Identified all 327 docBlame lint errors across 35 files: 252 in Bimodal/ (28 files) and 75 in Temporal/ (7 files). Zero in Modal/ (contrary to task estimate). Declarations are primarily proof-bearing defs (120+), canonical model components (50+), formula predicates/functions (40+), structure fields (58), and inductive types (11). Docstring style guide extracted from existing codebase examples. Recommended 6-phase plan organized by subdirectory.
